substeps.caption: DOOR LOCK pressed, the door swings open on its right-hand hinge, past square, showing the 150 mm vertical goniometer.
A powder sample on its holder goes in by hand onto the stage at the goniometer's centre.
Door closed and locked: the X-ray interlock lets the 600 W tube switch on; the lamp on top lights.
Scan, drawn see-through: the tube stays put, the sample tilts by theta and the detector sweeps 2theta from 10 to 90 degrees.
X-rays off, the detector parks and the door opens again.
Door shut. At 722 mm tall the MiniFlex just fits a tray: Kardex allows 727.5 mm.
